title: PAN Loop
text:
PAN Loop is the circuit road connecting Patel-Azad-Nehru Halls of Residence. This loop has PFC, saloon & xerox shops and Krishna Air Travels office along with it's eatery. The road is connected with Scholars' Avenue and School Road to Tech Market.

 Location
